What guests order

What guests order most

From the photos and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Poppadums and onion bhaji

17 Google reviews mention the poppadums and 5 the onion bhaji.

Tandoori chicken and vindaloo

7 reviews mention the tandoori chicken and 7 the vindaloo. Chicken madras, lamb tikka, jalfrezi and king prawns are mentioned twice each.

Portions and vegan options

One guest writes about generous portions and great service, another, who eats vegan, found great options and writes that the prices are quite affordable.

From the kitchen

Photos from the Facebook page and the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Seated without a booking

One guest came without a reservation on a quiet evening, got a table anyway and writes that drinks and food arrived very quickly.

Polite, helpful staff

Guests describe the staff as professional, polite and helpful, friendly and relaxed, and always willing to help.

Classic, relaxed atmosphere

One guest writes of a classic atmosphere, another that it smelled great and the lighting was relaxing, and calls the dinner a highlight of the holiday.

What guests say

Three of 697 Google reviews, 546 of them with five stars.
